title: Instant Weight-Space Consolidation for Long-Term Memory in LLMs
abstract: arXiv:2611.20759v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Agentic memory systems give LLMs persistent memory by extracting experience into text and retrieving it at query time, but the model itself does not evolve: however many interactions it has had, it starts each query the same. Extraction errors compound, implicit cross-session patterns that no single fragment states cannot be surfaced, and the construction cost grows with every conversation. Fine-tuning on past interactions does change the weights, but requires backpropagation at serving time and degrades on long histories. We introduce CLAM (Carried Latent Adapter Memory), which combines the strengths of both: a recurrent hypernetwork performs parametric consolidation, compiling a stream of session activations into a low-rank adapter in a single forward pass with no gradient steps and no language-model generation calls, while a complementary episodic buffer supplies verbatim detail at inference. translated_title: 面向大语言模型长期记忆的即时权重空间固化
translated_abstract: 智能体记忆系统通过将经验提取为文本并在查询时进行检索，赋予大语言模型持久记忆，但模型本身并不会随之演化：无论经历过多少次交互，模型在每次查询时都以相同的状态开始。提取误差会不断累积，那些没有任何单一片段能够表达的跨会话隐式模式无法被浮现出来，且构建成本随每次对话不断增长。对过往交互进行微调确实能改变权重，但需要在服务阶段进行反向传播，且在长历史上表现会退化。我们提出CLAM（Carried Latent Adapter Memory，携带式潜在适配器记忆），它结合了两者的优势：一个循环超网络执行参数化固化，在单次前向传播中将连续的会话激活流编译为一个低秩适配器，无需任何梯度步骤，也无需调用语言模型进行生成；同时，一个互补的情景缓冲区在推理时提供逐字的细节。一个门控潜在状态将知识跨（会话传递）
tldr: CLAM通过循环超网络在单次前向传播中将会话激活流即时编译为低秩适配器，无需梯度步骤即可实现参数化长期记忆固化，并结合情景缓冲区在推理时提供逐字细节。
en_tdlr: CLAM performs instant parametric memory consolidation by using a recurrent hypernetwork to compile a stream of session activations into a low-rank adapter in a single forward pass—without gradient steps or LLM generation calls—complemented by an episodic buffer that supplies verbatim detail at inference.
